# Collaboration and Contact

Providing channels for data access requests, academic collaboration, and feedback.
:::
:::

::: {.team-content}

## Academic Collaboration {.section-title}

This database welcomes academic collaboration in areas including land reform, economic history, rural development, historical geography, and digital humanities.


Potential collaboration includes:

- Conducting research based on the database;
- Improving variable design and database structure;
- Providing feedback on data quality and potential improvements;
- Sharing academic research outcomes.


## Data Access Requests {.section-title}

Researchers who wish to request access to the database should contact the project team.

Please provide the following information:

- Research objectives;
- Scope of requested data usage;
- Relevant variables or geographic areas;
- Expected research outputs.

## Feedback {.section-title #feedback}

Users are welcome to provide feedback regarding:

- Missing data;
- Issues with variable definitions;
- Coding errors;
- Additional information from local gazetteer sources.

Please contact the project team by email and provide relevant details.
